--- select_order_by_nulls.sql
SELECT x
FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
ORDER BY x ASC NULLS /* mode */ FIRST, x DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x ORDER BY x ASC NULLS FIRST, x DESC NULLS LAST
